rv.q: An offbeat cast of supporting characters injects much needed shots of adrenaline into the proceedings.
There's very little here to justify yet another look at Bruce's downfall
What should be an edge-of-your-seat courtroom drama feels a lot more like a law school lecture by an underprepared professor.

cn.t: Critics find this courtroom drama about Lenny Bruce's obscenity trial muddled and blandly directed, though the subject matter of free speech and comedy remains compelling. Reception is mixed to negative overall.
